name: Quest Self
vision_statement: Each Quest user meets one whole assistant.
opportunities: A person's day with their assistant is judged as they meet it, which no single part can show, so the whole assistant has its own measure of how capable it feels from the user's seat.
solution_coherence: Quest Self keeps every part of the assistant one specified whole, and Integrity is how it does that. Integrity checks that each part is a specified solution with a measured best implementation, so the package, its front door and its configuration stay one measured whole.
